question: Ustad Hassu Khan was one of the founders of which of the following Gharanas of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Hassu Khan was one of the founders of the Gwalior Gharana of music.**
 
• The Gwalior Gharana is one of the oldest and most prominent Gharanas of Indian classical music.
 
• The Gwalior Gharana is known for its emphasis on voice culture, clarity of notes, and intricate rhythmic patterns.<
